description: Gasleitungsnetz der Stadtwerke Delmenhorst GmbH is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data set includes the gas pipeline network of Stadtwerke Delmenhorst GmbH in the Delmenhorst supply area. The data show both the main lines and the house connections with the respective fittings. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Gas pipeline network of Stadtwerke Delmenhorst GmbH" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Mitteldruck Gasnetz, Produktions- und Industrieanlagen, inspireidentifiziert, Gasregelstation, Gas, Niederdruck Gasnetz. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
